hello.message: You are standing in front of a haunted mansion with an old door.

foyer.message: You are standing in a grand foyer. There is a marble table with a vase of dried roses and a dangerous spiral staircase.

B: Try to walk up the stairs

street.message: You are standing on the street at the end of the block. You have the impression you just escaped something really bad. You walk away and don't look back.

phone-outside.message: You call your friend Becca. She says your voice sounds weird and tells you to follow your heart.

rose.message: You pick up an old dried rose. A thorn pricks you. A drop of blood falls on a white lace doily. Suddenly you hear a voice yell 'WHO'S THERE?' You look up and see an old woman at the banister on the landing.

first-step.message: You step onto the first stair. It lets out a loud creak. Suddenly you hear a voice yell 'WHO'S THERE?' You look up and see an old woman at the banister on the landing.

yell.message: You yell 'WHAT UP GHOSTS?!'. Suddenly you hear a voice yell 'WHO'S THERE?' You look up and see an old woman at the banister on the landing.
